case.brief: Ms. Okafor's roll of gold star stickers vanished from her desk during recess. Gold stars are for finishing your reading book. Who took them?

herrings.backing: Someone used stickers in the nook. Who has the roll now?
herrings.lilysays: That's what Lily says. Is there anything that shows otherwise?
herrings.stars: Lots of new stars is suspicious, but where did the roll go?
herrings.time: Good, it happened at recess. Now find the roll!

hints: Who suddenly has lots of new stars?
Where do kids keep their stuff? Check the cubbies.

clue.d: The stars went missing during recess.

people.name: Ms. Okafor
people.says: The roll was on my desk before recess. After recess, it was gone.

people.name: Theo
people.says: I was outside playing tag the whole recess. Ask anyone!

clue.d: Says she earned all her stars.

people.name: Lily
people.says: I didn't take them! I earned all my stars. (She looks down at her shoes.)

places.name: Whiteboard
places.text: Today's goal: finish your reading book to earn a gold star!

clue.d: Lily's name suddenly has five gold stars.

places.name: Helper chart
places.text: Someone stuck five shiny new gold stars next to Monday: Lily.

clue.d: The missing roll is hidden in Lily's cubby.

places.name: Cubbies
places.text: Lily's cubby: the gold star roll, almost empty, tucked under her art folder.

clue.d: Someone peeled stickers in the reading nook.

places.name: Reading nook
places.text: Little star-shaped sticker backings are stuck to the beanbag.

places.name: Window
places.text: Closed and locked. The stars didn't fly away!

retorts: It wasn't me! Look at the clues again.
Hmm, that clue doesn't prove it. Try another one!
case.title: The Missing Gold Stars
case.wrap: Lily really wanted a gold star, so she took the roll at recess and gave herself five. She gave it back and said sorry, then finished her reading book and earned a real one.
